label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.13… supports A mover other than what it moves that is…
note: SCG I.13 [15] counts every mover of the series as an instrumental cause because it is a moved mover. That bears on this premise, which restricts the antecedent to a mover moved in a respect relevant to its moving. Gaps: the text states no respect restriction (it is stronger, and is not attributed this restricted form); 'instrumental cause' is typed here as not moving by the power of one's own form (DEF-MOVES-BY-OWN-FORM), which the sentence does not define; English-translation basis.
